requirements.text: The system must securely handle authentication for pre-registered users for all roles (Admin, Teacher, Student) and maintain strict, role-based access control to ensure privacy.

requirements.text: The system must strictly adhere to three and only three defined user roles (Admin, Teacher, Student).

requirements.text: User authentication must be implemented using session-based authentication, as opposed to token-based or third-party authentication.
